chunks: And by this chain of narrators, from Muhammad bin Uthman, he said: Ibn Abi Khaithama narrated to me, saying: Zuhair bin Muawiyah narrated to me from Ziyad bin Alaqa, Samak bin Harb, and Husain bin Abdur Rahman, all of them from Jabir bin Samra, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: After me, there will be twelve Caliphs.
Then he spoke some words which I did not understand. One of them said: I asked the people [about what he said], and they replied: He said: All of them are from Quraish.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about the number of Caliphs after him and their tribal origin?
ai.summary: This foundational hadith, prominently cited in Al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* to validate the Twelver doctrine, establishes the number and tribal origin of the twelve successors. While the specific names were initially obscure to the narrator, the clarification that all twelve are from Quraish serves as a key criterion in Shia scholarship for identifying the Imams, linking the prophetic tradition directly to the lineage of the Ahl al-Bayt.
